summary: Documented the existing server/client boundary, authoritative state owners, map and player lifecycles, turn lifecycle, presentation coupling, and responsive constraints.

commands.command: rg/Get-Content audit of the route, shell, map, stores, and simulation runtime
commands.evidence: The audit identifies WorldStateStoreController and ApplicationTurnRuntime as reusable owners and SimulationPanel/side-stack as presentation coupling to remove.

knownLimitations: This design stage does not yet extract the turn controller or replace the side-stack UI.
